name: Media
description: Background sound in notes, made in the browser with nothing fetched: `::noise{color=brown volume=0.3}`. And the media controller for whatever plays, noise or a video or track in a link embed: a mini player shows the one played last with its note, the status bar names it, and the keyboard's media keys pause and play it. A playing video floats in a small window while its note is out of sight (media.whenHidden).

media.why: Play background sound, and control what plays

media.whenHidden.description: What a playing video or track does when its note goes out of sight (another tab, the tab closed, or scrolled away). float: a video plays on in a small window you can drag, and goes back into the note when it shows again; a track plays on unseen, in the mini player. keepPlaying: both play on unseen, in the mini player. pause: both pause.

embeds.title: Background noise
embeds.description: White, pink or brown noise, for focus or sleep, made in the browser. Play it in the note; it keeps playing when the note closes, and the mini player controls it.

label.description: What it's called in the mini player
